roster: all genesis evaluators except the exact contribution author; at least two
closure: all eligible identities, never first arrival quorum
aggregation: minimum of all canonical bounded unsigned scores
deadline: existing signed submission round and candidate lifetime; no timeout vote
zero_or_missing: no model release or contribution reward
equivocation: same signer replacement is rejected; no objective guilt or slashing inferred
dispute: score disagreement is conservatively aggregated, not objective adjudication; no appeal authority added
